title: Jeffrey Ketland
text:
These are the webpages of Jeffrey Ketland.
I am retired Philosopher of Science. I retired in late 2025 as a Research Professor at the University of Warsaw. Prior to that, I have worked at the London School of Economics, and Kings College London, and the Universities of Nottingham, Cambridge, Leeds, Edinburgh, Munich and Oxford.
My CV can be found via the link in the sidebar. The other links in the sidebar include some Lecture Notes that I have written over the years, my Research & publications, blogposts and links to an older blog and to Substack, and some Shiny apps.

title: CV - Jeffrey Ketland
text:
This is my CV. A pdf version can be found here.
Born: 20 March 1964, Birmingham, England
Education
1975 – 1982: King Edwards Camp Hill School for Boys, Birmingham.
1982 – 1985: Trinity College, Cambridge. BA Theoretical Physics.
1985 – 1986: Trinity College, Cambridge. Part III Maths Tripos.
1990 – 1992: University of Warwick. MA Philosophy.
1994 – 1998: London School of Economics & Political Science. PhD Philosophy of Science.
Work
1991 – 1991: Teaching Assistant. University of Warwick.
1996 – 1998: Temporary Lecturer. Richmond College.
1996 – 1998: Teaching Assistant. LSE.
1998 – 1999: Temporary Lecturer. LSE.
2000 – 2001: Lecturer. University of Nottingham.
2001 – 2002: Post-doctoral fellow. Kings College London.
2002 – 2003: Temporary Lecturer. University of Leeds.
2003 – 2004: Temporary Lecturer. University of Cambridge.
2004 – 2011: Lecturer. University of Edinburgh.
2011 – 2012: Lecturer. University of Munich.
2012 – 2016: Associate Professor & Fellow. University of Oxford, Pembroke College.
2019 – 2025: Research Professor. University of Warsaw.
2025 – present: Retired.
